caption: The drawing depicts a simple outline of a jar or pot with a wide open mouth, two small handles—one on each side—near the upper section, and a rounded, bulbous body that narrows slightly towards the base. The outline is drawn with a thin, brown line on a cream-colored or aged, lightly stained paper. At the top of the jar, just below the rim and slightly curved to follow the jar's contour, is the text "NO 80 FURMAN ST. BROOKLYN, N.Y." printed in black, uppercase letters. The bottom right corner and part of the right edge of the paper show brown, irregular stains. There are no other decorative details or objects present in the drawing.
title: Crock
